title: TISSUE: uncertainty-calibrated prediction of single-cell spatial transcriptomics improves downstream analyses
authors: Sun, Ma, Navarro Negredo, Brunet, Zou
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal-style per-gene/per-cell prediction intervals for imputed (unmeasured) genes, calibrated on measured panel genes stratified by gene clusters; multiple-imputation t-tests for DE; no gene-set aggregate, no finite-population estimator over genes
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Uncertainty for imputed genes using measured genes as calibration set (genes treated as exchangeable); but per-gene, not signature-score estimand or design-based

title: Accurate prediction in reconstructed spatial transcriptomes does not ensure valid biological discovery (TIDEST)
one_line_what_it_does: PPI-style augmented outcome: imputed expression for target gene debiased with residuals of correlated measured 'anchor' genes (corr-weighted, top-5 neighbours from scRNA ref), plus spatial confounding adjustment; DE testing; names gene-set enrichment as future extension
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Residual-correction of imputed genes using measured genes = cross-gene PPI idea; heuristic, per-gene DE target, no sampling-of-genes design, no unbiasedness over gene population

title: Design and Estimation for Split Questionnaire Surveys
one_line_what_it_does: Design-based planned missingness over survey items: each unit gets a subset of K items; BLUE/composite estimators exploiting item correlations; cost-optimal allocation of items
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Sampling of variables (items) as a design variable with optimal allocation and estimators using inter-item correlation; classical analogue of panel sampling (but items are the targets, not summed)

title: A Split Questionnaire Survey Design
one_line_what_it_does: Splits questionnaire into modules, assigns random subsets of modules to respondents, multiple imputation of missing-by-design parts
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Planned missingness over variables + imputation (seen via secondary descriptions only)

title: Multiple matrix sampling / item sampling (Lord & Novick 1968; Shoemaker 1973; Madow 1972; Lord 1960)
one_line_what_it_does: Universe of K items sampled into subtests; unbiased estimates of mean/variance/SE of total (universe) score of examinee groups, with item sampling with/without replacement and stratified item sampling
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Item = gene, total score = signature score: finite universe of items sampled, unbiased estimator of universe score with SE; classical psychometrics (no ML predictions as auxiliary)

title: Accurate imputation of pathway-specific gene expression in spatial transcriptomics with PASTA
one_line_what_it_does: Imputation method that targets pathway-sum expression at each location with panel genes of the pathway as ground truth; uses TISSUE calibration score only as evaluation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Signature/pathway scores from partially imputed gene sets in targeted ST; no inference/intervals; point prediction only

title: Prediction-Powered Inference with Imputed Covariates and Nonuniform Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Predict-then-debias bootstrap CIs when ML imputes arbitrary subsets of features, complete data from nonuniform sample (weighted/stratified/clustered)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Imputed features with debiasing; units are rows not genes; regression targets not feature-sums

title: Towards Efficient Inference under Nonmonotone Missingness with General Imputation (RAY)
one_line_what_it_does: Efficient Z-estimation when different units observe arbitrary subsets of variables, unbiased for arbitrary imputation functions
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Planned/arbitrary missingness over variables with ML imputation; not a sum-over-features estimand

title: A Unified Framework for Inference with General Missingness Patterns and Machine Learning Imputation
one_line_what_it_does: PPI-type valid inference for Z-estimation with ML imputation under MAR and general missingness patterns via pattern-stratified masking-and-imputation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Generalizes PPI to missing covariates/outcomes patterns

title: Active Statistical Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Label with probability proportional to model uncertainty, AIPW estimator, optimal sampling rule
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Optimal prediction-guided unequal-probability sampling of units; would apply verbatim with 'unit = gene'

title: Probability Sampling Designs: Principles for Choice of Design and Balancing (cites Godambe & Joshi 1965; Isaki & Fuller 1982)
one_line_what_it_does: Anticipated-variance-optimal inclusion probabilities proportional to model SD (Godambe-Joshi bound), balanced sampling, difference/GREG estimators
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Optimal panel-design part of claim = classical optimal inclusion probabilities for the difference estimator

title: Model-Assisted Survey Estimation with Modern Prediction Techniques
one_line_what_it_does: Difference/GREG estimators with ML predictors are design-unbiased regardless of model quality
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-unbiased estimator with arbitrary predictions

title: PPI is the Difference Estimator: Recognizing the Survey Sampling Roots of PPI
one_line_what_it_does: Maps PPI estimator to survey-sampling difference estimator
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Core estimator identity already published

title: Stratified Sampling for Model-Assisted Estimation with Surrogate Outcomes
one_line_what_it_does: Neyman-type optimal allocation for model-assisted estimator with surrogate predictions on finite population
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Optimal-design analogue for units

title: Gene panel selection for targeted spatial transcriptomics
one_line_what_it_does: Simulated-annealing panel selection for cell type accuracy
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Panel design by classification accuracy not signature-score estimation

title: Probe set selection for targeted spatial transcriptomics (Spapros)
one_line_what_it_does: Probe set selection for cell type identification and within-type variation recovery
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Panel design; objective is variation recovery, not valid estimation of gene-set scores

title: Optimal gene panel selection for targeted spatial transcriptomics experiments (ReconST)
authors: Lu, Fang, Zeng, Zhong, Yuan, Ma
one_line_what_it_does: Gated autoencoder selects genes that reconstruct the full transcriptome
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Panel design for reconstruction accuracy; no inference

title: scGIST: gene panel design for spatial transcriptomics with prioritized gene sets
one_line_what_it_does: Neural feature selection with prioritized genes/pathways under panel-size limit
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Accommodates pathway genes in panel but for cell-type accuracy

title: scGPD: single-cell informed gene panel design
one_line_what_it_does: Dual-stage feature selection for panels recovering transcriptome-wide expression
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Panel design

title: Multi-view gene panel characterization for spatially resolved omics
one_line_what_it_does: Panel evaluation incl. pathway-level coverage
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Pathway coverage as a panel metric, heuristic

title: A Next Generation Connectivity Map: L1000 platform
one_line_what_it_does: Measure 978 landmark genes, infer ~11k others by regression; signatures need inference of remainder
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Historical precedent for panel + imputation-for-signatures; no design-based intervals

title: Efficient generation of transcriptomic profiles by random composite measurements
one_line_what_it_does: Random composite (linear-combination) measurements plus sparse module decompression recover unmeasured genes
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Randomized measurement design over genes (compressed sensing), model-based recovery

title: Pretrained gene representations transfer mean expression more broadly than spatial patterns in virtual spatial transcriptomics
one_line_what_it_does: Held-out-gene evaluation of virtual ST: most gain is gene-mean, little spatial
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Warning: held-out genes' predictability is mostly the mean, bears on whether gene-level residuals are useful

title: UCell and pyUCell: single-cell gene signature scoring
one_line_what_it_does: Offers 'skip missing genes' option for panel-based Xenium/CosMx signature scores
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Current practice = naive subset-of-genes mean (the baseline the claim improves on)

title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
one_line_what_it_does: PPI analogue for distribution-valued outcomes (perturbation response)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Not about genes as population; PPI generalization in genomics

title: Mitigating Bias in Spatial Transcriptomic Pipelines via Human Feedback (CSDE)
one_line_what_it_does: PPI with importance-sampled expert-validated cells for DE under segmentation error
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: PPI in ST, units = cells

title: Reliable imputation of spatial transcriptomes with uncertainty estimation (TransImpute)
one_line_what_it_does: Per-gene uncertainty predicted from features to rank imputed genes
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Gene-level reliability score, no coverage guarantee
